Interactive commands and all submitted targets are saved for the episode record.

import sys, json, os, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras']); counter=0
log=open('/app/output/commands.jsonl','a',buffering=1)

def record(o,name):
    global obs, counter
    obs=o; counter+=1
    path=f'/app/output/run{counter:03d}_{name}'
    o.save(path)
    for c,im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save('/app/output/'+c+'.png')
    json.dump(o.meta,open('/app/output/latest.json','w'),indent=2)
    print(path,'time_left',o.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    return o

def watch(seconds=0,name='observe'):
    return record(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,seconds=seconds,include_depth=True),name)

def qpos(): return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:14])
def targets(): return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][28:42])
def pose(side='left'):
    return np.array(obs.meta['cameras']['wrist_cam_'+side]['cam2world_gl'])
def move(q,secs=2,name='move'):
    q=np.array(q); start=targets()
    n=max(1,int(secs/.02)); a=start+(q-start)*np.linspace(1/n,1,n)[:,None]
    log.write(json.dumps(dict(name=name,targets=q.tolist(),seconds=secs))+'\n')
    return record(r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=.02,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='frames',video_fps=5,note=name),name)

def cloud(cam):
    im=obs.last[cam]; d=obs.depth[cam].astype(float)
    cal=obs.meta['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(cal['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(cal['cam2world_gl'])
    v,u=np.indices(d.shape)
    xyz=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],-d],-1)
    return xyz@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]

def redpoints(cam='overhead_cam'):
    im=obs.last[cam].astype(float); xyz=cloud(cam)
    mask=(im[:,:,0]>80)&(im[:,:,0]>im[:,:,1]*1.7)&(im[:,:,0]>im[:,:,2]*1.7)
    return xyz[mask]

watch()
print('READY',flush=True)
